answer: In an agent economy, require each new identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before it can earn reputation or access valuable jobs. A single operator can still create a canyon of fake agents, but each must tie up real capital; if agents default, collude in a task, or fail a sampled audit, their stake is forfeited. The marble ledger can record those losses, while a whisper of suspiciously coordinated behavior triggers review—not automatic guilt. Sybils remain possible, but manufacturing influence now has a measurable carrying cost.
